extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from reopened source figures/text; replaces automated pending-review locator notes without altering material packet inputs.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AC-P19 and AC-P19M disrupt lung cancer cell membrane integrity, with LDH release reaching positive-control-like levels and AC-P19M reaching maximal release above 20 µM.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AC-P19 and AC-P19M in A549 and H460 cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact per-concentration LDH bar values were not digitized; source-supported conclusion is membrane-disruption/cell-lysis evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AC-P19M induces apoptosis in A549 and H460 cells, supported by Annexin V/PI flow cytometry and apoptosis-marker western blot changes.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AC-P19M in A549 and H460 cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: Cell-cycle assay in Supplementary Figure S2 showed no significant cell-cycle effect; apoptosis is the supported cell-death mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AC-P19M suppresses lung cancer migration/invasion and EMT marker shift at non-cytotoxic concentrations.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AC-P19M in A549 and H460 cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: Evidence supports EMT-associated phenotype reversal; it does not establish a single upstream molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AC-P19M shows anti-angiogenic activity in HUVECs and attenuates VEGF-induced VEGFR2/Akt/ERK phosphorylation.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Evidence is an in vitro HUVEC model; not direct in vivo angiogenesis evidence.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Mechanism claims are limited to cell-line, RBC, and HUVEC in vitro assays in the opened local article and supplement.
